{{Top|leg}}
An '''emergency acceleration compensator''' was a safety device intended to protect the pilot of a [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]] in the event of a crash. It was designed to be used alongside a [[restraint harness]] and [[crash balloon]]s in order to prevent the pilot from being injured by hitting a hard surface during the sudden deceleration of a crash.<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> Luke Skywalker once survived a crash on [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] without injury thanks to an emergency acceleration compensator in a Skipray owned by [[Talon Karrde]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

==Behind the scenes==
This is the Star Wars analogue to an [[Wikipedia:Inertia dampener|inertia dampener]], a common device in science fiction.
